statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The Nasdaq-100 has held the same contained two-sided band for a sixth hour with both session extremes rejected and retracements intact, and VIX has eased slightly, while Stress stays elevated on the after-close Nvidia catalyst.
recommendation: Tail at 11 is well below the block threshold, so the deterministic mapping yields EA_ON. A narrow evidence-based danger window is published for 20:00-23:00 UTC, covering the Nvidia results at approximately 20:20 UTC and the 21:00 UTC conference call.
headline: Nasdaq-100 band holds a sixth hour into Nvidia's after-close report; Tail eases to 11, Stress elevated
body: At the assessment cutoff the Nasdaq-100 cash index trades near 29,193, down about 0.05% on the day, still inside the 29,096.84-29,264.87 session range set against a 29,209.23 previous close and a 29,130.77 open. Both session extremes are unchanged from the previous hour and both have been rejected, while price has recovered roughly 47 points from the prior reading back into the upper half of the band. That is a sixth consecutive hour of containment inside a range about 0.58% wide, so mean reversion is demonstrably functioning and no persistent one-way structure is observed. Nasdaq-100 futures near 29,252 in a 29,096.00-29,332.75 range confirm the same two-sided picture in continuous trade. VIX at 15.54 is up 0.09 points on the day inside a narrow 15.41-15.74 range and has eased slightly from the previous hour. The 2-year yield near 4.226% and the 10-year near 4.665% are up about 2 and 3 basis points respectively after the hot headline PCE print, an orderly repricing rather than a yield-led equity impulse. WTI near 82.60 dollars is modestly higher and Brent near 88.40 dollars modestly lower, following the Iran-Oman Strait of Hormuz arrangement that removes rather than adds a geopolitical amplifier. July PCE printed slightly hot on the headline at 0.2% month-over-month and 3.7% year-over-year against a 3.6% consensus, while core PCE held at 3.3% year-over-year and 0.2% month-over-month in line with expectations; the observed price path after that release has been orderly. Supplementary delayed cross-asset context shows dispersed megacaps, with Apple, Meta and Microsoft higher against Nvidia, Alphabet, Broadcom and Tesla lower, and a similarly split semiconductor tape. Conflicting breadth of this kind reduces directional conviction rather than establishing a mean-reversion failure. The dominant open question is the Nvidia fiscal Q2 report scheduled for approximately 20:20 UTC with the conference call from 21:00 UTC, which supports elevated Stress and a narrow published danger window while leaving Tail low, because pre-event dispersion is not an observed price path.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours Claude's published Tail stayed inside a 9-16 band and never reached a blocking level. Risk drifted lower through the 25 August US afternoon and overnight to a trough of 9, then held at 11 through the European morning while Stress climbed steadily from 45 to 57 as the July PCE release and the after-close Nvidia catalyst approached. The 12:00 UTC slot carried the release window at Tail 16 with an event/whipsaw mode; the 13:00 to 16:00 UTC slots then stepped Tail back down to 15, 14, 13 and 12 as the post-release path proved orderly and the session range held.
outlookSummary: The published path holds Tail at 11-13 through the remaining quiet US afternoon and the closing auction, lifts it to a 22-24 band across the 20:00-23:00 UTC window that covers Nvidia's after-close results and conference call, then normalizes it back toward 12-13 through the Asian and European overnight hours. The maximum forecast Tail of 24 keeps the deterministic mapping at WATCH and never reaches the block threshold, because pre-event dispersion is scored as Stress rather than as an already-observed price path. A step up to 15-17 is published for the 27 August 12:30 UTC jobless-claims block and the following 13:30 UTC US cash open, which delivers the first full regular-session verdict on Nvidia.
